# TerraWeave source import provenance

The complete TerraWeave 0.1.0 editable project was imported and committed to `main`.

The source payload was SHA-256 verified before extraction. Per-file hashes of the original source are recorded in `docs/SOURCE-IMPORT.json`. The static distribution, standalone HTML, ten npm archives and binary terrain fixtures were rebuilt using the delivered scripts. Browser screenshots were recaptured on GitHub's runner and the original browser workflow suite passed. Generated reports and examples may therefore differ from the earlier ZIP's bytes.

Source import commit: `b6ad8b68f6067ef184adb771a62c33876aaab92c`.
Distribution and validation commit: `fce1746dca6097b54bc5b223dc2134160ec9daff`.
Import validation: https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/TerraWeave/actions/runs/35508263631
Source payload SHA-256: `13febf2770e480601d59951580ea4162b7a337bef62c734a7bb30fd9eb7775f6`.

Temporary transfer files and the one-time import workflow have been removed from the current tree. The permanent Pages workflow builds ordinary source files; no archive transport or external source-download service is involved.
